uncited: This family encompasses methods for solving the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) and related transport problems in participating media.

Approaches range from deterministic angular discretization (Discrete Ordinates Method, Principal-Ordinates Propagation) and iterative integral equation solvers (Multiple Scattering Model) to analytical gradient computation for differentiable rendering (Differential Radiative Transfer, Differential Form of RTE).

Some variants employ approximation bases like Spherical Harmonics or Gaussians, while others adapt Monte Carlo techniques with signed distance functions (sMCRT) or ratio estimators for accurate shadowing.
The family covers both steady-state flux propagation and wave propagation formulations.
